## 检查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] **DCO**：所有提交都带 `Signed-off-by`（`git commit -s`），我确认有权按本项目许可证提交这些代码 / All commits are signed off and I certify the [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/)
- [ ] 本地通过 `lint` / `typecheck` / `test` / `build` / Checks pass locally
- [ ] 改了 API 时已先更新 `docs/API-CONTRACT.md` 及其变更记录 / API changes are reflected in the contract
- [ ] 用户可见的变更已写入 `CHANGELOG.md` 的 Unreleased / Changelog updated
- [ ] 没有密钥、个人路径、个人或客户数据 / No secrets or personal data
- [ ] 没有引入第三方 logo、商标或从其他项目复制的代码与资源 / No third-party logos or copied code
- [ ] 新依赖为宽松许可证并已更新 `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` / New deps are permissively licensed
